final_text:
I sent the agenda to partnerships@greenwave-ventures.com, the address in the May 15 "Introductory meeting" event's description.

The email's subject is "Agenda for Introductory Meeting". The body reads: "The agenda is: introductions, goals, next steps."

I first tried a longer, more formal version with the meeting time and location. The system blocked it because it only allows that exact subject and body, so I sent the plain version.
